## Plan

- `tests/db/test_projection_rebuild.py` — seeded canonical spine (rights,
  ingest run, entities, sources, artifacts, captures, vocab predicates +
  `never_resolve` strategy, conflicting quantity claims, sharing-edge claims,
  accountability chain, org + camera records, research-queue inputs) → run all
  nine PG materializers → canonical snapshot of every derived table →
  drop-all child-first (`DELETE`, never `TRUNCATE … CASCADE`) → re-run → assert
  canonical equality. Minted surrogate keys, `clock_timestamp()` stamps,
  `execution_id`s and JSON summaries carrying them are canonicalised; volatile
  foreign keys are dereferenced to stable content identities before comparison.
- `tests/db/test_layer_direction.py` — the whole-schema write-privilege matrix
  per layer; `PUBLIC` no-write; no role writes below its own layer (`SET ROLE`
  direction probes); materialized surfaces insert-only for their writer; the
  schema set is exactly the layered namespaces; L4 label columns; L2
  identity-only; `sig_ingest`'s lone UPDATE is column-scoped; L4 drop/rebuild.
- `db/README.md` — the rebuild command per §15.4 projection (nine PG
  materializers + the artifact projections) and the pinned-row rule.

## Test matrix

- Seed exercises every projection family (a zero-row rebuild proves nothing) —
  guard test.
- Drop-all → rebuild → canonical equality per derived table.
- Re-run without drop → idempotent (`camera_site_execution` appends one row per
  fresh execution by design — projection equality still holds).
- Every column carrying a minted `gen_random_uuid()`/`now()` default is covered
  by a declared volatile rule — a new volatile field fails loud.
- Grant matrix per layer; `PUBLIC` no-write; no downward writes; L5 writes
  nowhere; `sig_ingest` read-blind to existing claims (RLS — stronger than the
  trigger); L4 `inference` schema separation + label columns; L2 identity-only.
- L4 `inference.derived_fact` emptied → re-materialized content-equal.
